recap_lines: Congress / Federal:

HR 10147: To amend the Harmonized Tariff Schedule for the United States to establish a new subheading in chapter 39 for silicone prosthetics for women who are breast cancer survivors and a new subheading in chapter 90 for mastectomy bras.
Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.
HR 10148: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to clarify that certain exemptions from Federal income tax are not treated as Federal financial assistance.
Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

HR 10140: To direct the National Park Service to pursue options for the provision of mineral-based, broad-spectrum sunscreen or other protective methods at low or no cost in national parks, and for other purposes.
Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.
Plus 2 education, 4 economic, 1 technology, 1 tax bills, and 5 others.
1 hearings scheduled.
